answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 7328 Country: AF Title: Some people cut their some part of beard's hair from nose side is it batter or not? Question: Some people cut their some part of beard's hair from nose side is it batter or not? Answer ID: 7328 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1115/969=L/1429) It is allowable to trim the hair if they are at face adjacent to the nose. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
